target: Transactional cross-platform collector activation with bounded installed-effect proof and exact rollback.
invariants: The previous verified generation remains runnable until the candidate passes readiness and watermark proof.
Exactly one startup owner is authoritative and its argument vector and archive root are exact.
Raw archives, summary semantics, historical backfill, and cloud protocols remain unchanged.
allowed_changes: Add durable lifecycle journals, receipts, generation staging, restart policy, rollback, and bounded effect verification.
Remove the Windows Run-key fallback as a competing startup authority.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite or migrate any archive, summary, index, cloud, peer, or historical catch-up data.
Treat process existence or command exit zero as installed-effect proof.
before_after_checks: Inject failure before and after every lifecycle transition and compare the exact pre-state after rollback.
Verify multilingual and long-path argument vectors without shell reconstruction.
Prove bounded source and archive watermark convergence through the installed entrypoint.
